owner_note: User-owned. The facilitator agent launches ONLY runs listed here with status 'planned'. Approval is plan-level: `touch .guardrails/approve-lr-sweep` authorises exactly what this file describes. Design decisions (which lr, epochs, etc.) live here and nowhere else.

budget.expected_cost_usd: ~1-2 total for both runs (L4 $0.49/hr ~45 min/run; RTX 4090 $0.74/hr ~25 min/run)

infra.gpu_id_note: Verify exact --gpu-id strings against `runpodctl gpu list` at launch; 'NVIDIA L4' is confirmed from 2026-08-28.
infra.pass_api_key_at_create: Pod self-termination needs RUNPOD_API_KEY in the pod env. scripts/create_pod.sh reads it from ~/.runpod/config.toml and passes it via --env so the key never appears in chat.

runs.name: full-code15-lr1e-3
runs.note: Completed 2026-08-28 on RTX 4090 pod 8w09mq198ctjw4. AUROC 0.8276, AUPRC 0.1366, TPR@5%FPR 0.4127, TPR@top-5% 0.3875.

failure_policy.crash_or_nan: Report the log tail verbatim and halt the sweep. No retry, no flag changes. sweep_driver.sh enforces this: a run that exits without a test-eval block stops the sweep.
failure_policy.gpu_out_of_stock: Fall through gpu_preference_order once. If none available, report and halt; do not pick a GPU outside the list.
failure_policy.ssh_drop_mid_run: Reconnect and recover state from the run log; the driver and runs are detached and keep going.
failure_policy.budget_exceeded: Stop launching. Pull any finished outputs, delete the pod, report.
failure_policy.relaunch_after_failure: Not the agent's call. The user removes .guardrails/state/launched-<run> to authorise a second attempt.

triggers: all planned runs finished AND ./outputs_pulled marker exists (agent pulled results)
all planned runs finished AND 45 min elapsed with no marker (agent session died)
pod alive longer than budget.max_pod_hours (hard stop, even mid-run)
termination.failure_mode: If every termination method fails the driver writes ./TERMINATION_FAILED and logs it. Check `runpodctl pod list` and delete by hand.

end_of_session: scp checkpoints + train_<run>.log + train_<run>.meta.json to local lightning_logs/<run>/
fill notes/runs.md with the faithful-recording block for each run
touch outputs_pulled on the pod, then confirm `runpodctl pod list` returns []
